entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that receives and processes 5GMM/5GSM messages.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network infrastructure that receives and processes 5GMM/5GSM messages.

entities.name: 5GMM STATUS or 5GSM STATUS
entities.description: Status message sent in response to unknown or incompatible messages, containing cause information.

entities.name: Message type non-existent or not implemented
entities.description: Cause value #97 indicating the received message type is not defined for the EPD or not implemented by the receiver.

entities.name: Message type not compatible with protocol state
entities.description: Cause value #98 indicating the received message is not compatible with the current protocol state.

entities.name: Unknown message type
entities.description: Condition where a received message has a type not defined for the extended protocol discriminator or not implemented.

entities.name: Incompatible protocol state
entities.description: Condition where a received message is not compatible with the current protocol state.

relations.description: UE sends STATUS message when receiving unknown message type.
STATUS message contains cause #97 for unknown message types.
Unknown message type condition triggers STATUS message transmission.
Network sends STATUS message when receiving unknown message type in foreseen protocol state.
Incompatible protocol state condition triggers STATUS message transmission from UE.
STATUS message contains cause #98 for protocol state incompatibility.
